name: 15-merge-messages-single
description: The `single` option, the last of the four flags fixture 12 does not touch. At :872-885 every role is rewritten to `user` BEFORE the squash pass, and the assistant/user halves gain the character/user name prefix unless the content already starts with it. So [assistant, user] collapses into ONE user turn whose content carries both prefixes: the first turn's own 'Iris: ' suppresses a second one (:874), the second turn genuinely gains 'User: ' (:879). The assistant turn's tool_calls are then dropped because tools is false (:887-890). A port that applies the single prefixes AFTER the squash, or that skips the already-prefixed guards, diverges on the content string here.
